fichas.title: Hospitals: General, Modular Grid
fichas.summary: Overview of hospital planning, operational links, space guidelines, and the functional organization of general, teaching, and specialist hospitals. The page emphasizes economical room allocation, short connections between departments, flexibility, and smooth traffic flow. It includes a space guideline for a general hospital with approximately 300 beds and diagrams of departmental cooperation.
uses: Treating and caring for patients with acute and chronic illnesses
Teaching and research in university hospitals
